TextBlock.Text: THEATRE Karachi approaches
DATE 14 November 2028 · 0500 local
SIDE Pakistan Navy
WINDOW 120 min, closes at 180
Sea King naval family. Photo: NASA · Public domain · cropped
"Readiness is our first responsibility."
- Gen. Kenneth S. Wilsbach, Chief of Staff, US Air Force, 2025

KARACHI APPROACHES, 0500. MT LANDHI, MT KORANGI CREEK and MT THATTA SPIRIT weighed from the Karachi outer anchorage at 0300 with the month's fuel for Port Qasim and are on the deep-water route, twenty-four miles south-west of the Port Qasim anchorage. Three Meridian armed trawlers are coming in from the south-west, and an armed ro-ro, MV SEA FALCON, from the south.

MV MERIDIAN SENTINEL, their mothership, was off the Indus mouths at midnight. She is now running south for the open sea. If she clears the marked circle south of the delta, Meridian keeps the ship that fuels its boats.

Bring at least two of the three tankers within four miles of the Port Qasim anchorage. Stop SENTINEL before she clears to sea: sink her, or close her with the screen's lead ship to within about three miles, and she will heave to and follow your orders into the Karachi roads. From then she is a protected neutral; her loss ends the operation. Set the lead ship's weapons to Hold before closing her, or it may engage her on the way in. The convoy is in when two tankers are inside the anchorage circle, SENTINEL is sunk or has hove to, and no incoming weapon is still tracked against the task group.
Fishing dhows, a bulk carrier at the Port Qasim anchorage and the Dubai service are on the water and in the air. Identify before you fire.
COMMAND NET: A mission-specific tactical report follows eight minutes after the start. It is advice from the command team, not a new sensor detection.
Commander Pakistan Fleet, Karachi
COMMANDER'S INTENT

Bring the convoy in, and stop the mothership. SENTINEL is the trawlers' fuel and ammunition; if she stops, Meridian's boats have nowhere to go. A warship close aboard is enough to make her heave to, and a ship that has hove to is not fired on.
• Bring two of the three tankers within four miles of the Port Qasim anchorage
• Also required: stop Meridian Sentinel before she clears to sea, by sinking her or closing her until she heaves to
• Lose none of the three tankers
• Sink three of the four Meridian boats coming for the convoy
• Harm no dhow, merchant or airliner, nor Meridian Sentinel once she has hove to

Your task group, its flights and any Air Force aircraft allocated, out of Masroor. Convoy: MT Landhi, MT Korangi Creek and MT Thatta Spirit. Opposing: three Meridian armed trawlers and the armed ro-ro MV Sea Falcon; running: MV Meridian Sentinel, armed. Neutral: dhows, a bulk carrier and an airliner.

The planned window is 120 minutes. At that minute Command signals that you are behind schedule and holds the line for about 60 minutes more; the operation is closed at 180 minutes and the main task will be recorded as failed.
RULES OF ENGAGEMENT
All designated neutral contacts are protected. A protected neutral loss cancels the operation. Identify before you shoot.
